chunks: Say: "I am forbidden to worship those you call apart from God, since clear signs have come to me from my Lord, and I am commanded to submit to the Lord of all the worlds."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'I am forbidden to worship those you call apart from God' in Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse underscores the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) absolute obedience to divine command upon receiving the 'clear proofs' (al-bayyināt), a concept Shia scholarship often links to the Ahl al-Bayt's infallibility and deep knowledge. It highlights the transition from the polytheism of the Quraish to pure Tawhid, serving as a foundational text for the Prophet's mission to call humanity to the worship of the Lord of all worlds.
